newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:
Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Commissioner Karel Van Miert might hold a news conference on state aid to shipyards after Wednesday's Commission meeting.

Spokeswoman Elisabetta Olivi said Commissioner Mario Monti had met French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis on Monday. She said Monti had said that current Community legislation did not allow value-added tax (VAT) on CD-ROMs to be lowered. She said he did not see how this situation could be changed in the near future.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/224: Fisheries products: the Commission launches an information campaign for a better consumption and to preserve sea ressources.
- IP/97/228: EU/Madagascar cooperation: ECU 218.5 million for five years.
- IP/97/229: Citizens First - the dialogue begins.
- Speech/97/63: Speech by Commissioner Hans van den Broek on EU support for reform in Bulgaria.
- Memo/97/28: EC fact sheet on Caribbean nananas and the WTO.
- Provisional agenda of the Commission's weekly meeting on Wednesday March 19, 1997.
- European Fish Campaign - Health and Wealth from the sea - press kit.
